headline: Fuel measures to be announced on September 30 - heating oil measures on October 14
summary: Government spokesperson P. Marinakis said fuel measures will be announced on September 30 and heating oil measures on October 14. The measures will cover the first fortnight of October and include a Special Consumption Tax reduction.
why: Fuel and heating oil prices feed into household and business costs, and changes to consumption taxes affect inflation and retail fuel demand.
